name: citationlab-manager
description: Work in CitationLab Marketing Manager from ChatGPT: AI search visibility, SEO, analytics, paid ads, content and actions across your projects.

interface.longDescription:
CitationLab Marketing Manager connects ChatGPT to your marketing workspace, so you can ask about your own projects and follow up on them without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- AI search visibility: see how your brand shows up in AI assistants and AI search answers — mentions, citations, share of voice and the competitors that are cited instead of you.
- SEO: Search Console queries and pages, tracked keyword rankings, cannibalization, technical SEO audits and index status.
- Analytics: GA4 traffic, sources, page engagement and conversions.
- Paid media: Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and Microsoft Ads performance.
- Competitors and links: head-to-head comparisons, competitor activity and your backlink overview.
- Actions: see open actions and recommendations, and turn findings into tracked actions with owners, priorities and status.

You sign in with your CitationLab account and approve the connection. ChatGPT only sees the projects your account can already access. Everything except creating, updating and commenting on actions is read-only, and every change goes through the same permissions as the app itself.

Requires a CitationLab Marketing Manager account on a plan that includes AI connectors.
defaultPrompt: What can CitationLab do for my projects?
How visible is my brand in AI answers this month?
Which Search Console queries lost clicks in the last 28 days?
